cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A downplays itself as tool passer while deciding each small finishing step until B is effectively installing the shelf.
confusable: Not a direct large assignment: A turns B answers into apparently tiny next favors while retaining completion decisions.
comparison: Work-bound helper drawn into shelf assembly versus bouquet helper drawn into wiring and finishing.
